<title level="1" right="Class Feature 17">[Double Reflow](/Classes.aspx?ID=23)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 13

**Class** Kineticist

Your kinetic gate becomes even more adaptable. When you use reflow elements, you can replace two impulse feats instead of one.
